## 简体中文

### Esse 1.1.0-beta.11

- 移除后台提交后必须等待新用户消息才能查询和验图的工具限制。原任务或有效目标已授权跟踪、验图和限定次数返工时，Agent 可在原范围、预算和次数内继续；仅要求提交的任务仍可在后台受理后结束，真实客户端计划模式仍以规划和只读探索为限。
- 后台受理返回准确的批次、任务及追加/修改图片标识，便于继续查询。按原 requestKey 找回回执时先检查全部匹配，多个批次命中会明确报歧义，避免列表截断后猜错目标。
- 修复追加或修改保存失败后仍暴露回执、备份和待执行任务的问题。成功保存后才发布状态，避免后续无关调度执行未成功提交的返工。
- 续跑指导明确查询间隔、原始截止时间和验收条件；验收须读取实际图片并检查像素、尺寸和请求参数。未知提交或扣费只读对账，不自动重发；返工不扩大原模型、参考图、数量、预算或次数授权。
- 通过离线 MCP SDK、真实本地 PNG、保存失败和重启回归，以及 GitHub 托管 macOS ARM64 构建和隔离应用检查。未执行付费生图；真实 Codex/WorkBuddy 自主流程、真实 Provider 图片质量及实体 Apple Silicon Mac 安装启动尚未实测。轮询和预算说明是 Agent 指导，未新增服务端强制费用控制。

[完整变更记录](https://github.com/renoir1220/esse-private/compare/v1.1.0-beta.9...v1.1.0-beta.11)

## English

### Esse 1.1.0-beta.11

- Removes the tool restriction requiring a new user message before querying or inspecting background results. When the original task or active Goal already authorizes tracking, image verification and bounded rework, the Agent may continue within that scope, budget and attempt limit. Submit-only tasks may still end after background acceptance; actual client Plan mode remains limited to planning and read-only exploration.
- Background acceptance returns exact batch, job and appended/modified image identifiers for continued queries. Original-requestKey receipt recovery checks all matches before list limits and explicitly rejects multi-batch ambiguity, preventing selection of the wrong target from a truncated list.
- Fixes append/modify save failures exposing receipts, backups or queued work. State is published only after a successful durable save, preventing unrelated later scheduling from executing an uncommitted rework.
- Continuation guidance specifies query intervals, the original deadline and acceptance conditions. Acceptance requires reading actual images and checking pixels, dimensions and requested parameters. Uncertain submissions or charges receive read-only reconciliation without automatic resubmission; rework does not expand the originally authorized model, references, quantity, budget or attempts.
- Validated with offline MCP SDK flows, actual local PNGs, save-failure and restart regressions, plus GitHub-hosted macOS ARM64 builds and isolated packaged-app checks. No paid image generation was performed. Real Codex/WorkBuddy autonomous execution, actual Provider image quality and physical Apple Silicon installation/startup remain untested. Polling and budget limits are Agent guidance; no server-enforced spending controller was added.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/renoir1220/esse-private/compare/v1.1.0-beta.9...v1.1.0-beta.11)
